correctness.rationale: For every algebraically closed characteristic-three field, the five restricted quartic coefficients on a full Grassmann chart are computed explicitly. They exclude every nonzero-parameter line, including those on nodal fibers. At zero parameter they give 48 coordinate-pair and 64 non-coordinate lines with an exhaustive case distinction. The absolute Fermat normal bundle O(-2) makes the four unmixed equations etale in line coordinates; implicit elimination reduces each relative local ring to k[[lambda]]/(lambda q(lambda)). The constant q is nonzero on the 48; at a representative exotic line q=0 but q prime is 1, giving lambda squared. Diagonal fourth-root symmetry moves this computation to all 64. Total local length is 48+2*64=176. Two replayable exact scripts verified finite-field lines and tangent obstruction, without treating finite sampling as proof.

value.rationale: The Dwork pencil is a canonical mirror-K3 family and the Fermat special fiber has a maximally exceptional line configuration. Determining its entire relative Fano scheme is structurally informative: 48 lines are immediately obstructed and 64 survive as first-order but not second-order deformations; the scheme length 176 is not visible in the known 112 support count. The complete line-free behavior for all nonzero, even nodal, fibers is exact and motivated by this deformation geometry. This is not a routine numerical recomputation or arbitrary slice.
